source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) has endorsed voluntary medical male circumcision since 2007 as an efficacious intervention reducing HIV acquisition risk by approximately 60% in heterosexual men in high-prevalence settings, based on randomized controlled trials in Africa, with ongoing implementation in 15 priority countries. [77]
